description:
ExecutionContext::drive() (test-only entry, src/compiler2/drive.rs) on a context without sessions makes a fresh ProductSessions and calls drive_until without begin_standalone_drive. drive_depth() is then 1 inside a product drive that drive serves, so that drive arbitrates instead of deferring to the bare drain: the stall fz-sc8.181 closed for Compiler::drive() is still open on this entry.

Proof: drive_test a_bare_drive_that_makes_its_own_sessions_is_a_frame_too drives fixture 00882 through ExecutionContext::new(&mut world, &tel).drive(); on develop + fz-sc8.181 it observes no pull.drive.deferred event (expected depths [2,2,2]).

Reported by the fz-3sy.8 session: with fz-3sy.8 applied, 11 lib tests that enter this way stop resolving (3 in drive_test, 8 in jobs/semantic_test).

Fix: one function runs the bare drive and brackets it with its frame; Compiler::drive() and the session-less entry both call it, so a bare drive cannot start without being counted.
title: Every bare drive is a frame, wherever it starts
